```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
import sqlite3
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```


# connect to the database
```{python}
sqlite_file = "/home/justin/Desktop/Spring-2026/DSE-250/DSE-250-Data-Science/Unit3-task1/InClass/lahmansbaseballdb.sqlite"

conn = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_file)
```

# run queries
```{python}
q = "SELECT * FROM batting"

results = pl.read_database(q, conn, infer_schema_length=None)
results
```

```{python}
q = """
    SELECT *
      FROM managers

"""

managers = pl.read_database(q, conn)
managers
```




```{python}
(
managers.group_by("playerID").agg(
  pl.col("G").sum(),
  pl.col("W").sum(),
  pl.col("L").sum()
).with_columns(ratio=(pl.col("W") / pl.col("G")))
  .sort(pl.col("ratio"), descending=True)
  .filter(pl.col("G") > 150)
)

```

```{python}
q = "SELECT playerID, nameFirst, nameLast FROM people"
people = pl.read_database(q, conn)

best_manager_row = (
  managers.group_by("playerID")
  .agg(pl.col("G").sum(), pl.col("W").sum())
  .with_columns(ratio=pl.col("W") / pl.col("G"))
  .filter(pl.col("G") > 150)
  .sort("ratio", descending=True)
  .head(1)
  .join(people, on="playerID", how="left")
)

best_manager_row
```
